title: RuneLabs: New Area
question: The Guardians will be developing a whole new area of RuneScape this summer. Which of the following would you like to see being made? The actual content to be found in the winning area shall be determined in a later poll. Vote for all the options you like, the most supported idea wins.

title: Gower quest reward finalists
question: Last November we ran a "Design a Quest Reward" competition, and we have our 5 finalists! Now, you need to vote on your winner, which will be unlocked upon completion of the Gower Quest, due later this year. For full sized images and to join the discussion, head to the forum thread linked below!

title: RuneLabs: New Area
question: The Guardians will be developing the first region of the Eastern Lands this summer: the Arc islands. We have taken the most popular suggestions from RuneLabs, plus one of our own, and the winner will be included in our update later this year. Please vote for any options you like!

title: Favourite Update of 2016
question: What have been your favourite updates of the year in 2016? We will be discussing the results in our 2016 retrospective livestream on Tuesday 13th December, starting 5pm Game Time on Twitch. Choose up to 3 options.

title: Invention! Which interests you the most?
question: We recently posted a blog detailing our plans for Invention, which you can read by clicking the poll forum button. We would like to know which avenues of Invention interest you the most? This is a multiple option poll, you have up to 2 votes.

title: RuneLabs March '15 Poll
question: Here are the top most supported ideas for March 2015's RuneLabs large-only criteria. Pick your favourite. Click on the 'More Information' button to see details about the selected idea.

title: RuneLabs April '15 Poll
question: Here are the top most supported ideas for April 2015's RuneLabs medium-sized skilling criteria. Pick your favourite. Click on the 'More Information' button to see details about the selected idea.

title: RuneLabs Halloween Poll
question: Here are the top most supported ideas for May 2015's RuneLabs Halloween criteria. Pick your favourite. Click on the 'More Information' button to see details about the selected idea.

title: RuneLabs, High Level mobs
question: Here are the top most supported ideas for June 2015's RuneLabs high level mobs criteria. Pick your three favourites. The top three will be created, plus more if there is time to do so. Click on the "More Information" button to see details about the selected idea.

title: Future of RuneLabs
question: You told us that Runelabs ideas have not wowed you (click 'Poll forum' to find out more). Many of you mentioned a lack of Runelabs features, and we plan to improve them. In the meantime, we'll be reducing the number of Runelabs updates, but which would you prefer?

title: RuneLabs: July Update
question: We finally have our top RuneLabs quest ideas suggested by you - the players. Tell us which ones you think deserve to be developed - you can vote for all of the ideas you like, and the overall favourite will win!

title: Highlight of the Year
question: What has been your RuneScape highlight of the year in 2015?
c14: Ports Expansion: Guardians of the World

title: New Construction Room
question: In April, we plan to add a new room to your POH (this is not a complete Construction rework). We asked you for your suggestions on the Future Updates forum, and we have collected the best of them here. Now, we want you to vote for the new POH room!

title: High-level fish
question: An Aquarium was recently chosen as a new player-owned house room. We promised new fish types with that update, and we want YOU to choose what they do! Note that the theme and name of the fish will change, and each will require level 80 Fishing, regardless of what is chosen.

title: Skillcape Rework: Poll 2!
question: Last year, we polled a skillcape rework, which passed. Since then, we've been collecting your feedback on the forums to determine the new skillcape look. We'd now like you to decide the ultimate result! For better quality images, check out the forum thread.
c1: Tidy up, using the new skill icons
c2: Tidy up, using the old skill icons

title: Group bossing for Ironman
question: Fighting bosses across Gielinor is a core part of the end-game of RuneScape. What solution, if any, would you like as a strategy to deal with bosses in Ironman mode? Boss practice mode will follow the same ruleset. Only Ironman members may vote.

title: Opinion Poll: Update Size vs Frequency
question: We currently aim to release a core game update every week. Do you think it would benefit the game to have more significant but less frequent updates? Patch notes & ninja fixes would still be released weekly.

title: Limited-time event rewards
question: What kind of temporary event reward do you want to be available to Ironman accounts? Vote for as many as you want. Hover over each option to see more information about each option. Click on the 'poll forum' button to give further feedback in the forums.

title: February Seasonal Hiscores
question: Which of the following seasonal hiscores would you like to see next? We will poll more seasonal hiscores (as well as some options which didn't win) in future polls.

title: Guthixian Butterflies for Ironman
question: Guthixian butterflies are due to return to Gielinor soon, granting experience in the lowest skill of the catcher up to 20 times in a day. Should Ironman characters benefit from this experience? Only Ironman members may vote.

title: Elite Spawns
question: We are introducing elite rare spawns of existing combat creatures. These elite creatures will be slightly tougher yet provide an increased reward when killed. Which creatures would you like to see elite versions of? (Pick 3)

title: Ironman: Limited-time event XP
question: What style of temporary event XP that does not use up an Ironman's resources (such as stockpiled logs, ores, etc) is acceptable to you? Hover over each option to see more information about each option. Click on the 'poll forum' button to give further feedback in the forums.
Which of these two huge updates should we create first?

Do you want us to develop a 'Legacy Mode,' which would bring back most of the old combat gameplay and interfaces, alongside Evolution of Combat. You'd test this in beta until you were happy for release.
The combat level calculation is being reconsidered. What would you like to be used as the basis for an updated formula? Later polls will decide any further changes to the formula.
From the forums and fan sites, it's clear that you want more boss encounters in the game. The question is, what kind of boss encounter do you want us to release next?
Have your say in the theme of a quest coming out later this year. Check the full description for what we'll poll you should your choice win.
The RuneScape website team have some great ideas for new features on RuneScape.com, but we don't know which one to make first! Which one would you like to see?
In March, you decided that our October quest should have a '6th Age' theme. Now, we would like you to choose what that quest should be.

Distractions and Diversions are great for breaking up skilling and offering additional rewards. We've got loads of ideas for future small D&Ds (of similar size to the Evil Tree activity), but which skill should we make one for next?
In a previous poll, you decided that a 2014 quest would feature the Elder Gods. But which Elder God should be the focus of that quest? Mah and Jas will feature in other planned content.
Legacy Mode is an optional way to play the modern game, with a traditional look and the old-style combat. Once the remaining issues have been fixed in beta, should it be added to the main game?

title: Which quest?
question: Our developers have some awesome ideas for quests, based on conversations with the community. Which one should we start developing? This will not affect delivery of poll winners such as the quest to research the Elder Gods.

title: 200th Quest - Which City?
question: The 200th quest takes place in an alternate dimension, where you will re-visit a well-known city and complete twisted versions of your favourite quests. But which area would you like to be the focus of the quest? (Note that the city will not be reworked as part of this quest.)

title: 200th Quest - Which Quests?
question: The 200th quest will take place in an alternate dimension, where you will complete twisted versions of four Varrock quests. Demon Slayer and Defender of Varrock are guaranteed. Which quest would you most like to be featured? (Top two options will be selected)

title: Ironman Participation in Bonus Weekends/Events
question: Should Ironman and Hardcore Ironman accounts be able to gain from double xp and other bonus weekend events like regular accounts do in the future? Only Ironman accounts can vote on this poll.

title: Vampyres vs Floor 61
question: Late next year, we plan to release a 5th Age continuation quest. We want you to choose your favourite! Would you like a new vampyre quest, or Floor 61 of Daemonheim? More information on each quest can be found in the Poll forum.
Which group of creatures deserve to have their drop tables improved first?
